Description: Tier 2 classic per-user AppX removal target list. Applies on all Windows 11 editions. The Weather/Widgets board package is a separate opt-in. This is destructive and NON-EXACT: local app data can be lost; Apply removes only package instances sealed for the interactive user and verifies their absence. Restore-BloatwareApps validates the sealed session and original user, re-registers a recorded staged package family first, then uses the verified current Store product as fallback. It cannot recover deleted data, licensing, or a package version no longer staged/offered. Wildcards and guessed OEM patterns are forbidden.
